palette.toggleTheme: Switch between light and dark theme
empty.noRunHint: Load a seeded scenario from the Simulation Lab to see this view. Nothing is shown until real simulated observations exist.
landing.lead: ASTER connects breathing exposure, sensor reliability and exercise response in one offline-capable workflow — and shows what changed, how trustworthy the measurement is, and what evidence supports the next step.
landing.status: Research prototype demonstrated with simulated data. Not a medical device, not clinically validated, not flight-qualified, and not endorsed by NASA or any agency. Crew names are fictional.
landing.artSim: Illustration with invented shapes — not product data. Start the demo to see real simulated signals.
landing.a.exposure: Aligns local CO₂ measurements with the respiratory cycle and exposes sensor lag, sampling location and phase uncertainty.
landing.a.integrity: Uses a reference excitation, contact measurement and motion reference to decide whether a mechanical signal may be interpreted.
landing.a.exercise: Compares muscle-response features only between matched loads, with fluid-sensitive impedance kept as context.
overview.title: Mission overview
overview.lead: Current observations, measurement state and prioritised events for the selected crew member.
overview.noEvents: No active events. Nothing unsupported is being reported.
overview.coverageNote: Source, measurement state and interpretation status are separate labels. A connected sensor can still be unreliable.
chart.kbd: Use left and right arrow keys to move the time cursor; Escape clears it.
chart.hint: Hover, touch or use arrow keys to read exact values.
exposure.lead: Aligns the local gas measurement with the breath. The estimate is a time-weighted concentration during inhalation — not an inhaled dose, not end-tidal CO₂ and not a diagnosis.
exposure.coverageNote: Last 20 breaths with a supported estimate
exposure.lagNote: Diagnostic only. Declared sampling delay: {{declared}} ms
exposure.phaseOnly: Phase only — not airflow or tidal volume
exposure.caveat: Solid lines are measurements. Markers are per-breath values of the selected method; a cross on the baseline marks a withheld breath. Sampling near the face does not prove that the sampled gas equals the gas entering the airway.
exposure.historyNote: Accumulates only while an estimate is available. It is a concentration–time product, not a dose or a blood value.
exposure.notDose: Without a calibrated flow signal this is a time average, not a volume-weighted dose.
integrity.lead: Checks the measurement connection before interpreting a change. The reference excitation is an instrument operation; a passed self-check is not a physiological calibration.
integrity.calRequested: Calibration requested from the simulated instrument.
integrity.acceptedNote: Share of 2 s windows accepted without correction
integrity.noCal: No calibration has been evaluated yet.
integrity.calCaveat: The actuator path can differ from the path of a muscular signal. A calibration response that disagrees with the contact measurement is rejected rather than used.
integrity.methodNote: Gaps in the calibration-aware trace are intentional: rejected windows are not replaced by an invented value. Gain-compensated values are experimental and never feed the exercise comparison.
integrity.mapLabel: Sensor locations and their measurement state
integrity.mapNote: Location and quality only. Hardware concept — simulated, not manufactured.
exercise.lead: Compares like with like. A response deviation is shown only for matched load, cadence and valid repetitions; it is not a force measurement and not an atrophy diagnosis.
exercise.mmgNote: Uncalibrated PVDF amplitude in arbitrary units. Repetitions recorded during degraded contact are shown as unavailable.
exercise.impNote: Impedance is sensitive to fluid redistribution, exercise, movement and contact. A change is not evidence of muscle loss or dehydration.
exercise.noComparison: No comparison yet: at least four valid repetitions after warm-up are needed.
exercise.caveat: Within-person, observational comparison in simulation. It cannot show that an exercise countermeasure caused a change.
exercise.refComparable: comparable with the current session (load within ±12 %).
exercise.refNotComparable: not comparable with the current session
exercise.refsNote: Synthetic reference sessions produced by the same simulator and engine. Highlighted rows are used in the current comparison.
cases.lead: Evidence-linked events with their revisions, acknowledgements and case packages.
cases.autoQueue: Queue review and priority cases automatically
cases.outboxEmpty: No case package has been queued.
cases.outboxNote: Delivery acknowledgement and ground acknowledgement are different states. Packages stay available locally while the link is unavailable.
cases.notFound: This case does not exist in the current run.
cases.queued: Case package queued for the ground link.
cases.chain: Observation → quality → rule → evidence → next review step
cases.noGuidance: No guidance is linked to this rule.
cases.guidanceNote: Operational procedure not validated in this prototype. This is an illustrative workflow, not a medical instruction.
cases.stale: The ground reply refers to revision {{a}}. The local case is now revision {{b}}.
cases.replyNote: A reply is advisory text for human review. It is never executed as device control or treatment.
rule.EXR-DEV-01: Exercise response deviates from matched references
event.envCo2: Cabin CO₂ averaged {{ppm}} ppm over 30 s, above the demonstration threshold. This is an environmental observation, independent of the wearable channels.
event.expInhaled: Local inhalation-phase CO₂ estimate increased to about {{ppm}} ppm while the cabin trace reads {{cabin}} ppm. Phase alignment: {{phase}}; spatial sampling uncertainty remains.
event.expWithheld: The inhalation-phase estimate is withheld for {{withheld}} of the last 6 breaths. Reason: {{reason}}. The cabin observation remains available.
event.intContact: Mechanical signal changed while contact quality deteriorated ({{pct}} % of reference contact). Muscle-response interpretation is unavailable for this interval. Window decision: {{decision}}.
event.intCalRejected: The calibration response (gain {{gain}}) was rejected: {{reason}}. No correction is applied.
event.exrDeviation: At matched load the MMG response differs from {{refs}} reference sessions by {{pct}} % (z = {{z}}). Experimental indicator; evidence: {{strength}}.
event.exrNotComparable: This session cannot be compared directly. Reason: {{reason}}.
event.exrImpedance: Low-frequency impedance differs from the matched reference sessions by {{pct}} % while the response deviation is z = {{z}}. Fluid-sensitive change; no muscle interpretation is made.
event.dqStale: {{n}} previously present channel(s) stopped updating: {{channels}}. Dependent interpretations are unavailable; independent channels continue.
event.dqQuarantine: {{n}} record(s) were rejected and quarantined in the last 10 s. Latest reason: {{reason}}. Nothing was repaired by guessing.
guidance.checkContact.title: Check garment contact at the sensor site
guidance.checkContact.steps: Illustrative: inspect the fit at the thigh sensor, let the instrument repeat its reference calibration, and review whether accepted windows return. Review the case with the crew medical officer.
guidance.checkSensor.title: Check the data connection
guidance.checkSensor.steps: Illustrative: verify the sensor connection and power, confirm that samples resume, and note the affected interval in the case.
guidance.expVent.title: Review local ventilation context
guidance.expVent.steps: Illustrative: note location and airflow near the crew member, compare with the cabin trace, and review the evidence with the crew medical officer.
guidance.envReview.title: Review the environmental trend
guidance.envReview.steps: Illustrative: compare with other environmental instruments and follow the applicable reviewed procedure. This prototype contains no validated environmental procedure.
guidance.reviewCmo.title: Review with the crew medical officer
guidance.reviewCmo.steps: Illustrative: inspect matched sessions, signal quality and impedance context together before drawing any conclusion.
limitation.demonstration-threshold-not-c: Demonstration threshold — not a clinical limit.
limitation.simulated-data-not-clinical-e: Simulated data: this is software behaviour, not clinical evidence.
limitation.time-weighted-not-inhaled-dos: Time-weighted concentration, not a volume-weighted inhaled dose.
limitation.spatial-sampling-uncertainty: The sampled gas may differ from the gas entering the airway.
limitation.estimate-unavailable-not-zero: An unavailable estimate is not a zero or a normal value.
limitation.self-check-is-not-physiologic: An instrument self-check is not a physiological calibration.
limitation.actuator-path-may-differ-from: The actuator path may differ from the physiological signal path.
limitation.mmg-amplitude-is-not-force: MMG amplitude is not a direct measurement of force.
limitation.not-an-atrophy-diagnosis: This is not a diagnosis of muscle atrophy or any condition.
limitation.comparison-withheld: The comparison is withheld rather than forced.
limitation.impedance-is-not-fluid-volume: An impedance trend is not a fluid volume.
limitation.no-fabricated-continuity: Missing intervals are shown as missing; no continuity is fabricated.
limitation.rejected-input-not-repaired: Rejected input is counted, not silently repaired.
alt.exposure: Possible explanations include a real change in local ventilation, a change in sensor position relative to the airway, sensor response dynamics, or respiratory phase error.
alt.integrity: Possible explanations include garment movement, changed attachment pressure, a change in the actuator path only, or a real change in the mechanical source.
alt.exercise: Possible explanations include a real change in muscle response, different effort at the same external load, fluid redistribution, or residual coupling differences.
alt.environment: Possible explanations include a real cabin change or a drifting environmental sensor. Compare with independent instruments.
alt.data: Possible explanations include a disconnected sensor, a transport fault, a clock problem or a misconfigured device.
reason.sensor-bandwidth: gas sensor too slow for this breath
reason.lag-mismatch: observed lag disagrees with the declared sampling delay
reason.spatial-sampling-uncertainty: sampling location may not match inhaled gas
reason.self-check-failed: self-check failed; data kept, no correction applied
reason.reference-established: Reference established at the first calibration and frozen for this run.
reason.nominal: Calibration response and contact are consistent with the reference.
reason.coupling-change-confirmed: Calibration response and contact measurement both indicate a coupling change.
reason.path-mismatch: calibration response changed but the contact measurement did not (path mismatch)
reason.contact-changed-response-unchange: contact changed but the calibration response did not
reason.insufficient-calibration-data: not enough data during the calibration window
reason.load-mismatch: external load differs from every reference session
reason.cadence-mismatch: cadence differs from the matched-load references
reason.insufficient-references: fewer than three matched reference sessions
reason.no-reference-sessions: no reference sessions for this exercise
reason.insufficient-valid-repetitions: too few repetitions with valid sensor contact
ground.lead: Receives only the case packages that crossed the link. Operated by a person or an explicitly labelled simulated responder — not a live mission-control service.
ground.accelerated: Simulated link · shares the virtual clock
ground.linkNote: Configurable demonstration values, not an orbital calculation. Priority can shorten queue wait; nothing shortens propagation delay.
ground.none: No case has been delivered yet
ground.noneHint: Cases appear here only after the simulated link delivers them.
ground.cannedReply: [Simulated responder] Package received. Please confirm garment fit at the sensor site and send 60 s of contact force after the next calibration.
ground.replyNote: Replies travel back through the same delayed link and stay attached to this exact case revision.
lab.lead: Seeded, reproducible scenarios with fault injection. Hidden simulator truth is available only to the researcher role and never reaches the decision engine.
lab.galleryNote: Scenarios are bundled locally. The same scenario and seed produce identical observations and events at 1×, 10× and 60×.
lab.newRunConfirm: Loading a scenario creates a new run. The current run is preserved for inspection and export. Continue?
lab.resetConfirm: Reset creates a new run at time zero with the same scenario and seed. The previous run is preserved. Continue?
lab.scrubNote: Moving backwards pauses the run and opens read-only historical inspection. It never rewrites events, acknowledgements or delivered packages.
lab.faultsNote: Injections change the latent scenario for the selected crew member from now on. They are logged, so the run stays reproducible.
lab.needResearcher: Simulator truth is hidden in crew and medical-officer roles. Switch to the researcher role in Settings to evaluate.
lab.showTruth: Overlay simulator reference on the chart
lab.truthNote: The reference is the simulator's inhalation-phase mean concentration. Agreement in simulation is not clinical validation.
lab.heldOutNote: Exposure methods on {{n}} held-out seeds per scenario with varied sensor dynamics (see the validation report for integrity and exercise results and limitations).
lab.runEvaluate: Run “pnpm evaluate” to generate the held-out report. No result is shown until it exists.
lab.runsNote: Every execution has an immutable run identity. Replies and acknowledgements stay attached to their original run.
scenario.SIM-01.title: Quiet nominal baseline
scenario.SIM-01.description: Stable signals with a routine exercise session; no unsupported priority event should appear.
scenario.SIM-02.title: Local mixing change, stable cabin
scenario.SIM-02.description: Near-face ventilation drops while the cabin trace stays stable.
scenario.SIM-03.title: Exhalation spike only
scenario.SIM-03.description: Stronger exhaled plume at the sensor without an elevated inhaled reference.
scenario.SIM-04.title: Slow gas sensor, uncertain phase
scenario.SIM-04.description: Insufficient sensor bandwidth and a noisy respiratory signal: the estimate should be withheld.
scenario.SIM-05.title: Garment contact slip
scenario.SIM-05.description: Contact degrades during exercise; the dependent muscle interpretation should be suppressed.
scenario.SIM-06.title: Source change, contact stable
scenario.SIM-06.description: The mechanical source changes while attachment is stable; it must not be normalised away.
scenario.SIM-07.title: Calibration path mismatch
scenario.SIM-07.description: The actuator path changes but contact does not; the correction should be rejected.
scenario.SIM-08.title: Same exercise, changed response
scenario.SIM-08.description: Matched load with a different response: a bounded experimental deviation.
scenario.SIM-09.title: Different load, unchanged response
scenario.SIM-09.description: A heavier load than any reference: a like-for-like comparison should be refused.
scenario.SIM-10.title: Impedance shift, stable response
scenario.SIM-10.description: A fluid-sensitive impedance shift without a muscle-response change.
scenario.SIM-11.title: Combined exercise, exposure and contact
scenario.SIM-11.description: Exercise, altered local gas, contact slip and a link outage in one continuous run.
scenario.SIM-12.title: Link outage and duplicate receipt
scenario.SIM-12.description: A case waits through an outage, is delivered twice by the link and deduplicated on the ground.
scenario.SIM-13.title: Late reply to a superseded revision
scenario.SIM-13.description: A delayed ground reply arrives after the local case has moved to a newer revision.
scenario.SIM-14.title: Missing and malformed data
scenario.SIM-14.description: Dropouts, out-of-order records, duplicates and unit mismatches that must be quarantined.
scenario.SIM-15.title: Storage failure
scenario.SIM-15.description: A simulated storage quota failure with visible persistence state and recovery.
evidence.lead: Rules, methods, sources and the claim ledger bundled with this release. Citations are attribution, not endorsement.
evidence.demoLong: Demonstration threshold — not a clinical limit
evidence.claimsNote: Verified claims link to executed tests or the validation report in the repository. Prohibited claims must not appear in any release material.
evidence.sourcesNote: Source titles and summaries are kept in English. Links open the original publisher; the application itself needs no network access.
evidence.lim.sim: All physiological signals are synthetic. Simulator constants are engineering assumptions, not a validated digital twin.
evidence.lim.spatial: Near-face sampling mismatch cannot be corrected in software and remains a bias in the exposure estimate.
evidence.lim.transfer: Calibration transfer from the actuator path to a physiological path is unproven; gain compensation stays experimental.
evidence.lim.confound: Muscle-response features remain confounded by effort, fluid state and residual coupling.
evidence.lim.thresholds: Rule thresholds are demonstration settings and carry no clinical meaning.
evidence.lim.browser: In the browser profile, closing the tab or suspending the device stops acquisition and analysis.
evidence.ruleLang: Rule definitions are versioned technical text and are kept in English.
methodCard.cabin: Baseline: the cabin concentration is used as if it were inhaled.
methodCard.local-window: Baseline: mean of the near-face sensor over the whole breath.
methodCard.phase-gated: Baseline: mean of the near-face sensor during detected inhalation, without delay compensation.
methodCard.aligned-quality-aware: Candidate: shifts by the declared sampling delay, applies a first-order response correction and withholds the value when bandwidth, phase or coverage is insufficient.
methodCard.paired-reference: Baseline: least-squares cancellation against the motion reference.
methodCard.calibration-aware: Candidate: paired reference plus a gate driven by the reference excitation response and the contact measurement.
methodCard.unconditioned: Baseline: deviation from all reference sessions regardless of load.
methodCard.matched-conditioned: Deviation from sessions matched by exercise, load band, cadence and signal quality.
methodCard.fluid-aware: Experimental: matched comparison adjusted by a regression on low-frequency impedance.
methodCard.ablation-no-integrity: Ablation: matched comparison without the sensor-integrity gate (evaluation only).
claim.prototype: A simulation-first research prototype for offline, evidence-linked space health monitoring.
claim.offline: Runs offline after provisioning (browser profile; verified by automated reload test with the network blocked).
claim.resend: Persists and resends case packages across interrupted connections; duplicate deliveries are ignored.
claim.deterministic: The same scenario and seed reproduce identical observations and events at 1×, 10× and 60×.
claim.comparison: Candidate methods are compared with baselines on held-out simulated conditions; negative results are retained.
claim.emulator: Serial, WebSocket and replay paths are emulator-verified only.
claim.clinical: Clinically validated, flight-ready, patented or first-ever.
claim.nasa: NASA-approved, NASA-endorsed or using real astronaut telemetry.
claim.diagnosis: Diagnoses hypercapnia, predicts muscle atrophy or treats astronauts.
settings.lead: Preferences are stored on this device only.
settings.unitNote: kPa = ppm × 10⁻⁶ × cabin pressure. This is a gas partial pressure, not an arterial value. Stored units are always canonical.
settings.roleNote: The researcher role unlocks hidden-truth evaluation in the Simulation Lab. Crew role cannot acknowledge events.
settings.motionNote: Reduced motion removes route transitions and drawing effects. Status changes stay immediate. The system preference is also respected.
settings.retentionValue: {{min}} min of detailed streams in memory · {{runs}} runs listed
settings.wipePrompt: This permanently deletes all runs, cases and ground messages stored in this browser. Preferences are kept. Type RESET to confirm.
settings.storageNote: Browser storage is not encrypted. Only synthetic demo records are stored. Detailed streams are regenerated from the scenario, seed and command log.
settings.sw.none: Not installed (development server or first load)
settings.updateApplied: Update will take effect on the next load.
settings.offlineNote: After the first load the app, fonts and scenarios are cached locally. Updates are never applied automatically during a run. Closing the tab stops computation; the local gateway profile keeps running while its process runs.
settings.p1: No analytics, remote fonts, CDN, hosted AI or licence call is used.
settings.p2: Crew identities are fictional; case packages carry pseudonyms.
settings.p3: The optional camera preview is local only; no video is stored or transmitted and no inference is made from faces.
settings.p4: Real health records would require an explicit deployment threat model, access control and key management that this prototype does not provide.
settings.c1: Internet status and mission-link state are independent.
settings.c2: The simulated Earth link is an application-level store-and-forward model, not radio infrastructure or a DTN stack.
settings.c3: The local gateway binds to loopback by default and requires a token for any other interface.
devices.lead: Adapters, capabilities and connection health. Every integration states how far it has been verified; nothing here claims a hardware connection.
devices.inventoryNote: Verification levels: emulator-verified (exercised by the reference emulator through the real parser), recording-verified, hardware-verified, or not implemented. No adapter in this release is hardware-verified.
devices.tooLarge: The file is larger than the 5 MB import limit.
devices.sampleMissing: The bundled sample recording could not be loaded.
devices.replayNote: Imports are validated row by row. Ambiguous units, duplicates and non-monotonic timestamps are rejected, never guessed. Imported data keep the origin “recorded” and are inspected here; they are not merged into the simulated run.
devices.gatewayNote: The gateway and ground processes bind to 127.0.0.1 and exchange case packages over real HTTP at wall-clock speed. An HTTPS-hosted page cannot reach an insecure local WebSocket; serve the app from the local origin.
devices.serialOrigin: What is connected to the port?
devices.serialNote: Uses the documented reference frame with CRC-16 checking. The port prompt appears only after you press Connect. No physical device has been verified with this release.
devices.camNote: Local preview only. Nothing is recorded, stored or transmitted. Pose analysis is not implemented, and no emotion, identity, blood-pressure or SpO₂ inference is made from the image.
landing.artLabel: Illustration: when sensor contact slips, the mechanical interpretation is withheld while the breathing channel continues
